findings: Defects found and repaired during the story: component scan did not include module packages; Keycloak realm import file naming; test cookie jar dropped Secure cookies on localhost; synthetic last names failed Keycloak person-name validation; idle-expiry test initially edited the cleanup column instead of last access time; local realm note contained an unresolved ${...} placeholder; rendered realm file unreadable by the non-root Keycloak user.

Existing tests adjusted to new security semantics, not weakened: /actuator/env is now denied before routing (asserted denied with no environment data leaked); migration test now expects V1 and V2; error-handling probes run under a test-only permit-all chain for their probe paths only.

Residual: logout response gives the SPA its own ID token as id_token_hint (standard OIDC RP logout; ID token is not an API credential). Provider endpoint layout assumes Keycloak (O07 open). Staff grants, audit and object scopes are MB-011. Native on-device token handling is P07.
Positive staff MFA path is unit-tested with synthetic claims; a real MFA login was not automated in this story.

note: Attempt 1 FAILED: SECRET-SCAN flagged infra/.generated/identity/matbakhy-realm.json, an ignored local file the verify run had rendered with a random secret. Repaired by isolating verify output and scanning only committable files; superseded by 20261011-MB-009.
